text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease). The normal inflammatory markers (CBC, ESR, CRP) and lack of systemic symptoms like fever or joint pain, combined with a history of skin lesions in a pediatric patient, point toward Parvovirus B19. The "slapped cheek" rash is characteristic, often appearing before any significant lab abnormalities or severe systemic illness.
